methods.angles: Roll atan2(-gy,-gz); backward lean asin(-gx); tilt acos(-gz/||g||); yaw unwrapped from wxyz quaternion.
methods.com_zero: Only base_link additive COM perturbation made zero in x/y/z; original model COM retained.
methods.com_y_zero: Only base_link additive COM perturbation on y set to zero; x/z retain [-0.075,0.075]m and original model COM retained.
methods.random_sampling: Event objects and draw shapes retained via degenerate ranges; no event removed. Realized internal random parameters were not logged.
methods.scope: Same checkpoint model50000, seed42, one environment, 20 seconds; previous baseline and all-axis COM-zero results reused.

limits: One seed; directional robustness across initial states not established.
The y-only intervention is conditional on the remaining randomized dynamics; it does not establish multi-seed robustness or a linear COM response.
No foot-contact/force/position or actual COM/gain/delay traces; do not infer slip, pivot foot, exact random COM offset or actuator fault.
Task reward and PD code/config not changed.
